title: The Mixed-Up Bingo Balls
intro: Someone swapped the bingo cage balls for a set of squeaky rubber ducks, and the whole Sunset Lounge bingo night fell apart in a fit of honking.

suspects.name: Walter
suspects.line: I was at the piano, playing a very loud tune.

suspects.name: Mabel
suspects.line: I was dozing by the window, dear. Ask the cat.

suspects.name: Ruth
suspects.line: Rubber ducks? I'd never be so silly. Well, maybe once.

suspects.name: Harold
suspects.line: I don't squeak. I haven't squeaked since 1962.

suspects.name: Dot
suspects.line: I was only tidying the prize table, I swear.

clues.text: A walker's metal legs left no dents in the carpet here, so the walker was not the one who rolled through. Look elsewhere for the traveler.
Fresh cane-tip marks are missing from the soft dirt by this fern, so a cane was not used to get around. The mover was on foot.
A trail of soft humming hung in the air here, the kind of tuneless tune someone hums while sneaking about. Nobody's shoes were squeaking.
Clean footprints show that squeaky shoes did not walk this way. Whoever came here left no squeak at all.
